source: The same idea appears in ZXNAME0000XZ tiling, fused elementwise kernels, convolutions, reductions, and many compiler optimizations. Reuse matters because moving a value once and using it many times can be cheaper than fetching the same value repeatedly from farther away.
zh: 同样的想法也出现在 ZXNAME0000XZ 平铺、融合元素内核、卷积、约简和许多编译器优化中。重用很重要，因为一次移动一个值并多次使用它比从更远的地方重复获取相同的值要便宜。
